Watch Vishwatma, a classic Hindi action movie from 1992, in stunning 4K quality for the best viewing experience. Tune in on TV and enjoy the action-packed saga.
Prabhat, a policeman, and Akash, a reformed criminal, travel to Kenya to apprehend an underworld leader. However, they have to break the rules of the land upheld by Surya Pratap of the Kenyan police.
